Visit the museums      In Kimolos there are many interesting museums and art spaces, which are worth visiting, but two stand out. The Archaeological Museum is located in Chorio, opposite the Metropolitan Church of Panagia Odigetria.  It is housed in one of the oldest buildings of the settlement and has been operating since 2006.
